title: Polyamine Modulation through IP Injections
author: Ana Catarina Carapinha Cascalho
materials: Day 4/7/9/11/14/17/21/every week: Register weight of all mice.

Spermine tetrahydrochloride; (Thermo Scientific; J63060; CAS: 306-67-2; MW: 348.18 g/mol) (Spermine) Spermidine trihydrochloride (Thermo Scientific; 215100250; CAS: 334-50-9; MW: 254.63 g/mol) (Spermidine) Formula: Example

steps.title: Prepare DFMO Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare DFMO stock solutions (13 mg/mL or 25 mg/mL) using 0.9% saline.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve DFMO (CAS: 96020-91-6) from -20 °C storage.
Weigh the calculated amount of DFMO: for 13 mg/mL, add 0.13 g to 10 mL saline; for 25 mg/mL, add 0.25 g to 10 mL saline.
Seal the original container with parafilm, record the opening date if new, and register the Ref# and Lot# in the lab book.
Add the correct volume of 0.9% saline (VWR; 601780ZA) using a pipet.
Mix gently by inverting.
Once dissolved, filter the solution using a 0.22 µm filter (Carl Roth; SE2M035I07) connected to a syringe.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store DFMO
steps.instruction: Aliquot the DFMO solution and store at appropriate temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Create aliquots of a pre-defined volume.
Label aliquots with solution name and concentration (DFMO 13 or 25 mg/ml; 1X stock), date of preparation, and technician name.
Aliquot any leftover volume into a separate tube with a label specifying the volume.
Store aliquots in a box at -20 °C (stable up to 6 months) or -80 °C (stable up to 12 months).
Transfer all stock preparation information to the lab book.

steps.title: Administer DFMO Injections
steps.instruction: Perform daily IP injections of DFMO from P2 to P21.

substeps.instruction: On Day 2, check litter viability, prepare injection solution, paw tattoo for identification, and update health/behavior monitorization excel sheets.
Inject all pups daily from P2-P21 at roughly the same time each day using 0.9% saline vehicle.
Use working concentrations: P0-5 (350 mg/kg), P6-8 (400 mg/kg), and P9-P21 (500 mg/kg).
Register the weight of all mice on days 4, 7, 9, 11, 14, 17, 21, and every week thereafter.
After weaning (day 21), transition DFMO treatment to drinking water.

steps.title: Prepare DenSPM Stock Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare DenSPM stock solution (1.5 mg/mL) using 0.9% saline.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve N1,N11-Diethylnorspermine tetrahydrochloride (DenSPM; Torcis, CAS 156886-85-0) powder from room temperature storage.
Weigh the necessary amount of DenSPM in the appropriate recipient.
Seal the container with parafilm, record the opening date if new, and register the Ref# and Lot# in the lab book.
Add the correct volume of 0.9% saline using a pipet.
Mix gently by inverting.
Once dissolved, filter the solution using a 0.22 µm filter connected to a syringe.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store DenSPM
steps.instruction: Aliquot the DenSPM solution and store at appropriate temperatures.

substeps.instruction: Create aliquots of a pre-defined volume.
Label aliquots with solution name and concentration (DenSPM 1.5 mg/ml), date of preparation, and technician name.
Store aliquots in a box at -20 °C (stable up to 1 month) or -80 °C (stable up to 6 months).
Transfer all stock preparation information to the lab book.

steps.title: Administer DenSPM Injections
steps.instruction: Perform daily IP injections of DenSPM from P2 to P42.

substeps.instruction: On Day 2, check litter viability, prepare injection solution, paw tattoo for identification, and update health/behavior monitorization excel sheets.
Inject all pups daily from P2-P42 at roughly the same time each day.
Use a stock of 1.5 µg/L and an injection dose of 60 µg/g or 40 µl/g (e.g., 80 µL for a 2 g mouse).

steps.title: Prepare Spermine or Spermidine Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare spermine or spermidine stock solutions (25 mg/mL) using 0.9% saline.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve spermine or spermidine from 4 °C storage.
Weigh the calculated amount to reach a concentration of 25 mg/mL in the appropriate recipient.
Seal the container with parafilm, record the opening date if new, and register the Ref# and Lot# in the lab book.
Add the correct volume of 0.9% saline using a pipet.
Mix gently by inverting.
Once dissolved, filter the solution using a 0.22 µm filter connected to a syringe.

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Spermine/Spermidine
steps.instruction: Aliquot the solutions and store under nitrogen to prevent degradation.

substeps.instruction: Create aliquots of a pre-defined volume.
Label aliquots with solution name and concentration (spermine or spermidine 25 mg/ml; 10X stock), date of preparation, and technician name.
Aliquot leftover volume into a separate tube with a label mentioning the specific volume.
Replace the air in the tubes with a nitrogen atmosphere to reduce amine degradation.
Store aliquots in a box at -20 °C (stable up to 1 month) or -80 °C (stable up to 6 months).
Transfer all stock preparation information to the lab book.

steps.title: Prepare and Administer Spermine/Spermidine
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh working solutions and perform daily IP injections from P2 to P14.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 2.5 mg/mL working solution by diluting the stock 1:10 (e.g., 1 ml stock + 9 ml 0.9% saline).
Prepare the compound fresh every changing day from -20 °C stock tubes.
On Day 2, check litter viability, prepare injection solution, paw tattoo for identification, and take tail tissue for genotyping.
Inject all pups daily from P2-P14 at roughly the same time each day.
Use a dose of 40 µl/g for SPD (Spermidine) and 20 µl/g for SPM (Spermine) for lowered SPM injections.

steps.title: Final Collection and Processing
steps.instruction: Collect samples and process aliquots on Day 14.

substeps.instruction: On Day 14, collect blood via the facial vein.
Collect brain tissue (2 x 1 half hemisphere).

For aliquot processing: carefully open the tube lid, place the pipette tip into the tube on the side without touching the liquid, wait for 10 seconds (00:00:10), and quickly close the cap. Repeat for all aliquots.
